description: List discussion topics in a course with unread counts and whether you must post before seeing replies. Read-only. Set only_announcements for announcements; read a thread with get_full_topic_view.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

only_announcements.description: If true, return announcements instead of discussion topics.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

name: list_topics
title: List Topics
